source: Maine Revenue Services 2026 withholding formula (W-4ME basis, reproduced in NFC bulletin NFC-26-1771620053, eff. pay period 04-2026): standard deduction $12,450 single / $27,750 married; exemption $5,300/yr per allowance; tables 5.8% / 6.75% / 7.15%. CLOSEST-FIT EXCEPTION: the standard deduction PHASES OUT ($102,250–$177,250 single / $204,550–$354,550 married) — the phase-out is not modeled, so wages inside/above those ranges under-withhold; reconcile via extraWithholding.
